title: Ashbury Rewards Tier Benefits Chart: Welcome Units for Longer Stays
content:
Ashbury Rewards elite members on longer stays receive the welcome amount more than once. The welcome units depend on the tier and on the nights stayed, and the welcome amount is given once for each welcome unit. The nights stayed are the whole calendar days from the actual check-in date to the actual check-out date, read from the stay's Room Reservations record.

## Chart

| Tier | Nights stayed | Welcome units |
|---|---|---|
| Platinum Elite, Titanium Elite or Ambassador Elite | 2 or more | One unit for every two nights stayed, an odd last night earning nothing |
| Platinum Elite, Titanium Elite or Ambassador Elite | 1 | No further units under this chart |
| Silver Elite or Gold Elite | 4 or more | One unit plus one more for every four nights stayed |
| Silver Elite or Gold Elite | 1 to 3 | No further units under this chart |
| Ashbury Rewards Member | any | No further units under this chart |

In words: a member at Ashbury Rewards Platinum Elite, Titanium Elite or Ambassador Elite with two or more nights stayed receives one welcome unit for every two nights stayed, an odd last night earning nothing; a member at Ashbury Rewards Silver Elite or Gold Elite with four or more nights stayed receives one welcome unit plus one more for every four nights stayed.

## Worked figures (hypothetical stays)

| Tier | Nights stayed | Welcome units |
|---|---|---|
| Platinum Elite | 2 | 1 |
| Platinum Elite | 5 | 2 — two pairs; the odd fifth night earns nothing |
| Titanium Elite | 8 | 4 |
| Gold Elite | 4 | 2 — one unit plus one for the four nights |
| Gold Elite | 9 | 3 — one unit plus two for two sets of four nights |
| Gold Elite | 7 | 2 |
